move: two portrait columns wipe in from opposite ends, drift apart, names glide
how: Two tall image columns reveal by clip-path in opposite directions: the left from inset top 100%→0 and the right from inset bottom 100%→0 (expo.inOut 1.1s, 0.15s apart) while their inner layers counter-move yPercent ∓10→0 from scale 1.1 (expo.out 1.8s). Small uppercase captions fade up (stagger 0.08) and two large serif name words slide in from x -200 and x +200 with opacity (move 0.9s). From 37% to 92% the hold is a vertical parallax: the left image drifts yPercent 0→5, the right 0→-5, and the name words glide x ±30 the other way, all sine.inOut over 2.2s. Exit at 85%: each column wipes closed the way it opened (expo.in 0.6s), names slide back out with expo.in and captions fade.
adapt: Replace the two portrait images, the two name words and four caption strings, and the paper colour; keep the 1.1s opposing wipes with the 10% counter-move and the 2.2s drift.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the two columns, names and captions; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with wipes at 0-0.3D, drift 0.37-0.92D, exit at 0.85D. '.ca'/'.cb'/'.n1'/'.n2' become el-scoped; from() tweens need immediateRender:false.
